title: Details on Stepped-up Surveillance for Central Kitchens, Including Different Classification for those Supplying School Meals
what_it_is: Details on Stepped-up Surveillance for Central Kitchens, Including Different Classification for those Supplying School Meals

sections.label: Licensing of central kitchens
sections.summary: Central kitchens are licensed by the Singapore Food Agency and inspected more frequently due to their larger scale of food processing or preparation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Central kitchens are licensed by the Singapore Food Agency (SFA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: They are subjected to more frequent inspections as they have a larger scale of food processing or preparation.

sections.label: Food safety lapses and school meals
sections.summary: Kitchens with major food safety lapses are downgraded and inspected more regularly, and since August 2025 SFA has stepped up checks on central kitchens supplying school meals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the event of a major food safety lapse, they will be downgraded upon completion of suspension or Court conviction and inspected more regularly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since August 2025, SFA has stepped up checks on central kitchens supplying school meals under the Ministry of Education's (MOE's) Central Kitchen Meal Model programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Goh Hanyan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SFA and the Communicable Diseases Agency will continue to work closely with MOE schools and their appointed central kitchens to strengthen the food safety management systems from kitchens to when the food is transported, stored and distributed for consumption.

sections.label: Sourcing from licensed importers
sections.summary: SFA requires all importers and manufacturers to comply with food safety requirements, and central kitchens and all food establishments should source from these licensed importers and manufacturers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: First, SFA requires all importers and manufacturers to comply with food safety requirements and central kitchens and in fact, all food establishments should source from these licensed importers and manufacturers.

sections.label: SAFE grades in Government procurement
sections.summary: Phase 1 was implemented on 19 January 2026, and for all Government procurement the SAFE grades of suppliers and central kitchen providers are taken into consideration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: For all Government procurement, we then take into consideration the SAFE grades of these suppliers and central kitchen providers to ensure that they have a proper track record of food safety, due to past inspections and the results of that.

sections.label: Uni-directional process segregation
sections.summary: A uni-directional process helps to segregate ready-to-eat from non-ready-to-eat food products.

sentences.speaker: Ms Goh Hanyan
sentences.text: For example, adopting a uni-directional process, meaning that it helps to segregate ready-to-eat from non-ready-to-eat food products.
